## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-platform` 技能在 ADR-0146 定制段把 `action` 列入可声明覆盖的类型,并补一句讲清 action 覆盖能改什么、不能改什么;`metadata-lifecycle.mdx` 删掉"action 覆盖尚未提供"的过时句,改写为同样的规则;技能评估加一条 action 覆盖用例。
- 为什么改:PR #30497(落地 ADR-0146 D9)与 PR #30612 之后,action 覆盖已经可用,但技能和文档仍说不行,AI 会写错或绕路克隆。
- 风险与回滚:只有教学文字,无代码、无 schema 变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR。token 净增 1(6009→6010,上限 6011),靠同文件压缩付账,未动上限。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 定制段新增的 action 句与压缩处;`content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` 第 130–146 行;`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` 用例 15。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到 `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md is 6010 tokens (ceiling 6011; headroom 1)`。
- 需要你做的:受管面(`skills/**`,Tier H),需治理审批人批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`** (the ADR-0146 customization paragraphs): `action` joins the list of types a pair's declared override is honoured for, and one sentence teaches what an action override may change. It keeps the base's `objectName` (the doors match the base's action as `OBJECT:NAME`; an override on another object is refused `declared_package_ships_no_such_item`) and replaces the behaviour (`type`, `body`, `label`, `visible`, …) whole, for whoever could already run the base. Dropping a `requiredPermissions` entry, turning `ai.exposed` on, or turning `ai.requiresConfirmation` off is refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` with rule `declared_action_widens_access`.
- **`content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`**: the sentence saying an `action` override waits for ADR-0146 D9 and is not served is gone; `action` is in the type list, and a new bullet states the same rules in full prose.
- **`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`**: new case 15 (relabel and re-script a packaged action, and a request to widen who may run it); case 13's type list gains `action`. The platform evals carry one case per taught override rule (cases 12–14), so the new rule gets one too.
- **`.changeset/30505-skills-declared-action-override.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

Every fact was read off `origin/main` `b77c160a`, not off the card: `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION.action` (`disposition: 'overridable'`) in `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts`; `actionOverrideWidening` and the `declared_action_widens_access` / `declared_package_ships_no_such_item` refusals (`403`, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`) plus the `OBJECT:NAME` shipper filter in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`. The confirmation key is `ai.requiresConfirmation`, nested under `ai` like `ai.exposed`, so the skill spells both that way.

## Why

PR #30497 opened the declared override for `action` (ADR-0146 D9), and PR #30612 added the `objectName` rule. The skill still listed the overridable types without `action`, and the docs page said an action override was not served. An agent reading either would refuse or clone a package's button instead of overriding it.

## Token ratchet (`skills/**`)

| Reading | Before (`b77c160a`) | After (`17e0285f`) |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` lines | 426 | 413 |
| `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` tokens (ratchet count, ceiling 6011) | 6009 | 6010 |
| All 11 `SKILL.md` files, lines | 4534 | 4521 |
| All 11 `SKILL.md` files, tokens | 56667 | 56668 |

The addition (~100 tokens) is paid in the same file, with no ceiling raise. Each cut removes words, never a re-wrap:

- The customization paragraph is tightened ("one it does not ship", "a base-shipped locale", "never judging `basedOn`").
- The `strict: false` fence becomes one inline sentence.
- The four "Moved verbatim to" pointers read "See", and the Part 2 / Part 3 pointers drop "moved verbatim to".
- The two single-section `bootstrap.md` pointer stubs (§ Multi-App Composition, § Complete Working Example) merge into the pointer above them, so one line names all four sections.
- Two observations are dropped: "the example apps carry it" (engines stamp) and "All three example apps use it" (`onEnable`). The `defineStack()` warn sentence is shortened; the example warning text it introduces already says the value is dropped.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` L208 (ADR-0126 table) still names only the switch-off route for a packaged action. That route still exists (`packaged-base-regime.ts`), so it is not false, but the page does not mention the declared override as the path for changing an action. That line is outside this card's file surface. Noted, not filed.
